finding: the 5 framework/styles/layouts/* pages (dashboard, gallery, mail, feed, split) that DEMONSTRATE library patterns are themselves all the SAME outer shell - Sidebar + doc prose ('Rail and content') - the pattern named lives inside a small boxed mockup, not as the real page's own layout. Site-wide the near-universal PAGE-LEVEL shell is just three shapes: Rail+content (by far most common - home, all of /framework, /blog, /michael), Docs/three-region (Rail+content+TOC - every blog post via ext/toc), and Columns row (Finder shape - all of /imagine/, core/Page's columns demos). Tile/card walls, reading columns, galleries etc. are CONTENT-level patterns living inside those shells, not page shells of their own. This is the honest simple categorization the owner asked for.
